# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Thief, member of the Clockwork Gang

## Appearance

Pidgeon is a young, slight street urchin with a disheveled appearance. He wears worn, oversized clothing suitable for sneaking through narrow alleyways. His quick, darting eyes and nervous posture reflect a life spent on the run.

## Personality

Pidgeon is skittish, desperate, and survival-oriented, shaped by his harsh upbringing on the streets. Though easily frightened, he possesses a strong sense of loyalty to those who offer him protection. He is prone to panic under pressure but proves resourceful when backed into a corner.

## Traits

- Skittish and anxious
- Loyal to his companions
- Fear of authority and enforcement

## Abilities

- Pickpocketing and sleight of hand
- Stealth and navigating urban backalleys

## Goals

- Survive day-to-day life on the streets
- Earn his keep within the gang

## History

Pidgeon operates as a low-level thief and informant within the city's criminal underworld. He becomes involved in the escalating conflict involving the main party when he accidentally steals an item of major significance. Fearing for his life, he attempts to leverage the item for protection and money, but draws the attention of dangerous factions. Despite seeking refuge with allies, he is targeted by ruthless operatives seeking to recover the stolen secret. He ultimately meets a tragic end when he is murdered to keep him from testifying or revealing what he saw.

## Background by volume

- Grew up an orphan in the city's poorest slums before being taken in by street criminals

## Affiliations

- The Clockwork Gang — Thief and runner
